invariants.description: Any check failure MUST result in DENIED; no partial-admit path.
Admission checks MUST execute in fixed constitutional order.
No mutation type may exceed its configured rate limit per window.
A DENIED mutation MUST observe its cooldown before re-admission.
TIER2+ blast radius MUST have HUMAN-0 pre-authorization.
All admission ledger entries MUST form an unbroken HMAC-SHA256 chain.
Admission ledger entries are append-only; no edits or deletes.
Only HUMAN-0 may override a DENIED admission decision.
All admission decisions logged with ISO-8601 timestamps.
TIER3 mutations require quorum readiness confirmation before admission.
